title: (dev 3.1.1.2) Bug in Preferences from AutoISF-Plugin
body:
The value of “variable SMB delivery ratio. mapped glucose range” changes automatically to a very high value, if you set value <39. To reproduce the error, please enter a value <39 and exit the settings. When you call up the settings again, the high value will be displayed.  

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dc71753e-63b4-4498-98a2-c0d4cfcb1e89)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49911869-8adc-4794-86fd-5dbfc5d30761)

comments.body: I got the impressin that there is a recent problem with UnitDouble Keys. Until clarified/solved enter those "smaller" ranges as mmo/L numbers without actually selecting mmol/L as your units.

38 * 18 = 684
It  Looks like it converts the entered range from mmol/l to mg/dl
Ready to be closed; see above
